notes: Privileged role-grant alerts are now net-new only: PIM activations of existing eligibility never alert, and re-grants to accounts that already hold or are already eligible for the role are suppressed with the reason logged.

Converting an account's gated PIM eligibility into a permanent assignment is flagged as the escalation it is — the incident names the removed activation gate, on the sentence, the Assignment card and the alert row.
Pre-fix activation alerts self-heal: rows whose granter was MS-PIM auto-resolve with the reclassification reason in the case journal.
